summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<asset>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily-obfuscated bundle (string-array with rotator `WV8StW` shifting `n7gIxM`, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner) whose purpose does not correspond to the package's advertised role (a React CSS repo config). The alternate-runtime pattern causes the payload to execute under Bun rather than Node, so Node-based tooling and lifecycle-hook inspection never observe what the payload does. The chain fires automatically on `npm install` via the `preinstall` lifecycle script and results in opaque, publisher-chosen code running on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
